description.value: Refire Kitchen is a prepared-meals concept where customers select from a rotating menu of fully cooked entrées, soups, and desserts that simply need to be reheated at home. The Sidney location on Beacon Avenue is one of four stores spanning Greater Victoria, making it a convenient stop for cyclists touring the Saanich Peninsula. The menu spans comfort-food classics to vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-friendly options.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 81m; rack (8 spaces, covered) at 89m; rack (5 spaces) at 91m. Total: 21 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Refire Kitchen at 2506 Beacon Ave, Sidney is an active multi-location prepared-meals shop offering fully cooked take-and-bake entrées, soups, and desserts for in-store purchase or pre-order pickup. The /collections/full-menu page explicitly labels multiple items as VEGETARIAN, VEGAN, and GLUTEN FRIENDLY, confirming dietary options. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; phone 250-544-9197 sourced from website's Sidney location contact page.

OSM tags this as amenity=fast_food, but the business is a prepared-meals / take-and-bake shop — not a traditional fast-food operation. Category remains Food & Drink but the sub-type may warrant an OSM tag correction.
